dataset_name: NASA/ESA AGBRESA & UTMB Bed Rest Cardiovascular Analogue Dataset
original_source: NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA) & DLR :envihab AGBRESA Campaign
mission_or_experiment: 60-day Strict -6 degree Head-Down Tilt (HDT) Bed Rest Analogue Study
known_limitations: Controlled Access: Requires submission of NASA NLSP Data Request for full continuous ECG/BP records.
Ground analogue mimics cephalad fluid shifts and bed-rest deconditioning; lacks deep-space radiation co-factors.
Small cohort size (N=24) requires subject-stratified cross-validation.
usage_and_access_restrictions: Controlled Access: Requires NASA Life Sciences Portal (NLSP) HRP Data Request approval.
